text:
lia: Heads-up — I'm planning to prune legacy /v1 endpoints from the docs next Tuesday (will start with examples, links, and SDK snippets).

samir: ok — do we have a PR list? can we do it in small chunks? :+1:

lia: I'll open a single meta PR that removes dead routes and adds redirects, then smaller follow-ups for snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428

maria: need to confirm SDK rename surface — we changed `client.v1.invoke()` -> `client.invoke()` last quarter. If snippets still call `v1` they'll break.

kevin: I can sweep JS/TS snippets. Will grep for `.v1.` and `"/v1/"` and open fixes. Also will add a smoke test in CI.

samir: don't forget embedding docs — old embed alias `embed-v1-small` -> `embed-lite-v2` swap might affect dimension notes

lia: good catch. I'll add a migration table in the PR description mapping old endpoints and model aliases to new ones.

kevin: for code blocks, prefer the new call pattern. e.g.
```
// old
await client.responses.generate({ model: "embed-v1-small", input: "..." })
// new
await client.responses.generate({ model: "embed-lite-v2", input: "..." })
```

maria: can we add a short note about deprecation headers? apis will respond 301 -> we should tell users to update host paths.

lia: yes — I'll add a short example deprecation header and link to the redirect mapping file.

docs-bot: created checklist issue #298 in docs repo and added "prune-legacy-endpoints" label

samir: timeline? we should avoid breaking customer apps. propose staged roll: docs-only first, then SDK releases, then server redirects removal in 4 weeks.

lia: plan: docs PR opens Mon, docs publishing Wed, SDK quickfixes by end of week, redirect removal 30 days after announcement. I'll post a formal deprecation message in #announcements tomorrow.

kevin: tagging me on PRs. I'll add smoke tests that fail if any snippet still references `/v1/`.

maria: also add note in migration guide about model swap impact on embedding dims and retraining indexes.

lia: added to PR. thanks all :tada:

kevin: one more — check archived blog posts for hard-coded examples. I'll run a linkfinder sweep.

docs-bot: linked PR to issue #298 and auto-added reviewers: @kevin @maria @samir

lia: closing loop — will ping here when PR is ready for review.
